latestVersion.changelog:
gongwen-format 1.0.0 initial release

- Generates Chinese official documents (公文) following standardized formatting.
- Supports GB/T 9704-2012 national standards and common enterprise requirements.
- Provides clear font, size, margin, and hierarchy specifications for all elements.
- Includes document structure and common公文类型 (notice, report, decision, etc.).
- Sample code templates provided for docx-js (JavaScript) and C# OpenXML.
